captured_from.head: 9bf012997dbe2e5978c5b48edbd2dd35a8ecd055
captured_from.how: the launcher port recorded each case from launcher.py new (the incumbent) while it still existed, in the same test run that required new.ts to agree; volatile values are masked by the test's own mask().

amended: tap-k0jwy hand-added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_VIEW=1 to every claude env; the recorded incumbent predates it. tap-2njq3 hand-amended the claude cosmetics to the shipped defaults: CLAUDE_CODE_SCROLL_SPEED=4 and CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER=1 added.
why: Frozen outcomes of `launcher.py new --dry-run` across the launcher-new-oracle cases (status, stdout, stderr; chooser prompts as PTY transcripts). new.ts must reproduce them.
